sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Medical imaging and nuclear medicine: a Lancet Oncology Commission》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The diagnosis and treatment of patients with cancer requires access to imaging to ensure accurate management decisions and optimal outcomes.

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】We propose actions and investments that would enhance access to imaging equipment, workforce capacity, digital technology, radiopharmaceuticals, and research and training programmes in LMICs, to produce massive health and economic benefits and reduce the burden of cancer globally.

evidence.text: The diagnosis and treatment of patients with cancer requires access to imaging to ensure accurate management decisions and optimal outcomes.

We propose actions and investments that would enhance access to imaging equipment, workforce capacity, digital technology, radiopharmaceuticals, and research and training programmes in LMICs, to produce massive health and economic benefits and reduce the burden of cancer globally.
